summary.text: Jason Powell is a Democratic member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 53, where he has served since 2012, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Powell is the only candidate listed for the District 53 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jason Powell received a B.A. in history and political science from the University of Colorado at Boulder and a Master of Public Administration from Tennessee State University.
He has worked in real estate and nonprofit management.
Powell has represented District 53 in the Tennessee House since 2012.
In the 2023–2024 session he was assigned to the Civil Justice, House Ethics, State Government, and Transportation committees.
His 2012 campaign website, as quoted by Ballotpedia, listed jobs, education, safe and livable communities, and fiscal responsibility as themes.
